entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: First evincar of Rath, a former town elder of Coracin who betrayed his village to Croag and was partially compleated.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Artificial plane that Davvol first ruled as evincar.

entities.name: Coracin
entities.description: Village of which Davvol was town elder.

entities.name: Croag
entities.description: Phyrexian who sought the Gift of the Gods and took Davvol to Rath.

entities.name: Gift of the Gods
entities.description: Ancient machine kept in Coracin's vault.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Davvol was charged with killing.

entities.name: Phyrexian Negators
entities.description: Phyrexian creatures Davvol evolved and improved to kill Urza.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Site of an assault in which Croag was badly injured.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: Owner of genetics research that Croag tried to steal.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Structure whose information Croag stole from Davvol.

events.summary: Davvol betrayed the townspeople and told Croag how to access the vault.
events.quote: Davvol betrayed the townspeople and told Croag how to access the vault.

events.summary: Davvol was partially compleated to grant him eternal life.
events.quote: To grant him eternal life, Davvol was partially compleated

events.summary: Davvol proclaimed himself the first evincar of Rath after Croag was injured.
events.quote: Davvol proclaimed himself the first evincar of Rath.

events.summary: Croag used a grafted skullcap to steal Davvol's knowledge and left him to die, ending his reign.
events.quote: Davvol's reign ended when Croag used a grafted skullcap on Davvol

relations.quote: Davvol also began conducting planeshifting experiments for Croag
